title: Migrating Legacy Inventory Systems to Managed Cloud SQL
business: Retail organizations managing legacy on-premises relational databases for inventory tracking.
problem: High operational overhead and maintenance costs associated with manual patching, backups, and scaling of on-premises database servers.
solution: Utilizing Google Cloud SQL to offload database administration tasks such as automated backups, high availability configuration, and patch management to a fully managed service.
steps: Assess current database schema and compatibility with Cloud SQL supported engines (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server).
Provision a Cloud SQL instance with appropriate compute and storage resources.
Configure network connectivity via Private IP to ensure secure access from application servers.
Perform data migration using Database Migration Service to synchronize legacy data to the cloud instance.
Update application connection strings to point to the new Cloud SQL endpoint.
outcome: Reduced administrative burden and improved database reliability through automated maintenance and managed high availability.
limitation: Cloud SQL instances have specific resource limits; users must monitor CPU and memory utilization to ensure the selected machine type remains sufficient for workload demands.
